recognize_zh: 周邊血液中散布數顆中型母細胞，箭頭所指的細胞核邊緣有一塊淡染、形狀像杯口的凹陷（cup-like nuclear invagination），核質比高、細胞質少且無顆粒，符合杯狀母細胞。
features: Medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio and a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Pale, sharply outlined cup-shaped nuclear invagination in several blasts (arrows)
Round to slightly oval nuclei with fine chromatin
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules visible
Occasional smudged cell; red cells unremarkable
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm. Several blasts contain a pale, clearly demarcated cup-like nuclear invagination (arrows). Auer rods are not seen, and a smudged cell is present. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blast morphology, a pattern associated with NPM1 mutation and FLT3-ITD.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL shows bilobed or reniform nuclei and frequent Auer rods rather than a round nucleus with a single cup-like invagination.
Lymphoblasts do not show cup-like invaginations; MPO negativity and lymphoid markers on flow cytometry separate them.
Monocytic cells have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and folded or convoluted nuclei rather than a punched-out pale invagination.
